_doc: Backfill overlay for spark/spark-facilitator/20261001-2208 (scripts/backfill-decisions-contract.ts). Plain wording for the rows the run's build memo never covered (Phase 1, the work order, the solicitation, the programme copy), the two inherited-row calls the memo made in prose rather than in its provenance appendix, and the Phase 5 rows the fork re-ran under the same ids (evidence: run_state phases.ocs-setup.status_note — fresh bot, composed-prompt audit, collection 604, 3/3 quick prompts).

system-prompt-baseline.plain: The support chatbot uses instructions written for this programme on top of the standard chatbot setup.

rag-collection-scope.plain: The support chatbot answers from the design, Spark's own source material, the app guides and the training pack.

archetype-selection.plain: The programme is built as repeated visits to the same community, which moves through the FCAP steps in order.

pilot-scope-window.plain: The pilot covers the Goal Setting part of FCAP, steps 1 to 7.

pilot-app-form-slice.plain: The field app has three forms: facilitator registration, community enrolment, and the meeting record (with savings from Step 5).

meeting-verification-predicate.plain: A meeting is paid only when the record says "the meeting happened" and "it was a community meeting".

reused-vs-new-app.plain: The pilot uses its own app, separate from Spark's live app, but keeps Spark's question names so a later move into Spark's app is cheap.

longitudinal-entity.plain: Each community is tracked as one record that follows it from meeting to meeting.

entity-registration-path.plain: A community is added to the pilot through a separate Community Enrolment form, which also records its number of households.

visit-sequence-and-cadence.plain: Facilitators meet each community weekly, moving through FCAP steps 1 to 7.

payability-against-history.plain: Up to 3 meetings per community on each FCAP step are paid; a meeting cannot be recorded against an earlier or skipped step.

payment-unit-entity-id.plain: Each paid meeting is identified by its community, its FCAP step and its place (1st, 2nd or 3rd) on that step, so a 4th meeting on a step is not paid again.

visit-ownership.plain: A meeting is paid only when it is recorded by the facilitator who owns that community.

case-state-read-write.plain: Each meeting record starts from the community's current step, meeting count and household count, and saves back the new step, attendance and savings.

step-pointer-ownership.plain: The pilot keeps its own record of each community's step and never changes the step in Spark's own app.

progression-affects-payment.plain: A community that moves slowly through the steps is monitored, but the facilitator's pay does not depend on it.

entity-completion.plain: A community has finished the pilot when Step 7 (Vision) is marked complete; no further meetings are paid after that.

savings-block-gating.plain: Savings questions are asked only from Step 5 onward, when communities have started saving.

household-count-source.plain: A community's number of households is recorded once, at enrolment.

gps-per-meeting-capture.plain: Each meeting's location is recorded with its accuracy, for review only; it never stops a record or a payment.

duplicate-detection-key.plain: A repeated meeting is recognised by its community, step and meeting number, not by location.

verification-layers.plain: Payments are checked three ways: the record's own answers, a supervisor's review of a sample, and confirmation calls to community contacts.

layer-b-sample-design.plain: Supervisors review 20% of paid meetings, including every flagged meeting plus a random draw.

app-runtime-default-language.plain: The apps open in English; a worker can switch language.

learn-assessment-gate.plain: The training ends with a 12-question check; a worker passes with 10 correct (80%).

payment-rate.plain: The design proposes paying workers 5,000 to 10,000 MWK per verified community meeting.

opportunity-dates.plain: The design proposes delivery from 2 November 2026 to 26 February 2027.

connect-delivery-type.plain: The programme runs under Connect's general "ACE" delivery type, because none of Connect's types describes community-meeting facilitation.

primary-metric-vs-goal.plain: The pilot measures whether meetings were facilitated and paid correctly, not community outcomes, which arrive long after Step 7.

primary-metric-denominator.plain: Meeting regularity is measured against the weeks each community is active in the pilot.

named-downstream-consumer.plain: Pilot data feeds payment; whether Spark's monitoring team will also use it is not yet confirmed.

ai-fallback-design.plain: No AI scoring is used; people review a structured sample of meetings to check the automatic checks.

solicitation-type.plain: Implementing organisations are invited through an expression of interest rather than a priced tender.

candidate-llo-roster.plain: The call is listed publicly and also names FOCCAD, Spark's existing Malawi delivery partner, as a possible candidate.

fcap-step-taxonomy.plain: Only FCAP steps 1 to 7 are used in the pilot, each under Spark's own step name.

verification-flags.plain: Connect is set to pay only records where the meeting happened and was a community meeting; it does not use its duplicate or location flags.

cbfs-per-community-malawi.plain: In Malawi, one facilitator works with each community.

community-contact-for-layer-c.plain: Community enrolment records Spark's usual community contact and asks whether they agree to confirmation calls.

wo-number.plain: The Work Order number is assigned when the contract is signed.

wo-period-of-performance.plain: The Work Order runs from 26 October 2026 to 12 March 2027: an onboarding week before delivery and two weeks of closeout after.

wo-payment-schedule-split.plain: The organisation is paid 40% up front and 60% against verified meetings.

wo-mobilization-advance-pct.plain: The up-front advance is 40% of the cap, to cover setup and training before the first paid meeting.

wo-ethics-scope.plain: The work handles personal data about workers and community contacts, and meeting photos, but no medical data.

wo-data-storage-region.plain: Data is stored on servers in the United States, to be confirmed before signature.

llo-payment-per-visit-revised.plain: The design proposes paying the implementing organisation 3,000 MWK per verified meeting, as a floor to be reset from its own costing.

budget-plausibility-revised.plain: The design proposes a total budget of 3,276,000 MWK; expected spend is about half of that.

wo-total-not-to-exceed-revised.plain: The contract cap is set when the contract is signed; the indicative ceiling is 3,276,000 MWK.

per-flw-caps-revised.plain: Each facilitator can be paid for at most 1 meeting a day and 21 in total (7 steps, 3 meetings each).

deliver-unit-count.plain: Only the community meeting record is paid; registration and enrolment are recorded but not paid.
deliver-unit-count.check_at: Deliver app › Community meetings › Community Meeting Record

deliver-ambiguity-entity-id-grain-vs-cap.plain: The design fixed how a paid meeting is identified, and also said the 4th meeting on a step is not paid; the build keeps the design's identifier and adds a "paid slot" marker so both hold.

sol-solicitation-type-2208.plain: The call is published as an expression of interest; the rate, district and timing are for respondents to propose.

sol-response-deadline-2208.plain: Responses are due by 15 October 2026, for work from 26 October 2026 to 12 March 2027.

sol-response-template-choice-2208.plain: Respondents answer nine questions, including their district, their proposed rate and their review capacity.

sol-devices-and-system-of-record-2208.plain: The call does not ask about phones or data; the rate is all-in, split between the worker and the organisation.

connect-latitude-program-name-spark.plain: The Connect programme is named "Spark FCAP Community Meeting Facilitation — Malawi Pilot 2026".

connect-latitude-program-dates-spark.plain: The Connect programme runs from 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027, covering delivery and closeout.

connect-latitude-program-budget-ceiling-.plain: The Connect programme's budget ceiling is 32,760,000 MWK, room for later runs; it is not the pilot's cost.

connect-ambiguity-program-currency-spark.plain: The Connect programme is new and priced in Malawi kwacha, so the design's warning about a US-dollar programme does not apply.

opportunity-end-date-spark.plain: The Connect opportunity closes on 26 February 2027, including a two-week buffer.

connect-latitude-total-budget-spark.plain: The Connect opportunity's total budget is 3,276,000 MWK, as the design proposes.

connect-latitude-opportunity-dates-spark.plain: The Connect opportunity runs from 2 November 2026 to 26 February 2027, as the design proposes; the start was not moved earlier to make test meetings payable.

open-question-recording-path-whole-commu.plain: The paid form requires a group photo, and there is no way to record a meeting where the whole group declines the photo, so a meeting that happened could go unpaid.
open-question-recording-path-whole-commu.check_at: Deliver app › Community Meeting Record › meeting photo
